subject: Clearstream implementation credit request + tiered support options
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@clearstreamhealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearstreamhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Pricing / migration credit question for private deployment

Diego,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency profile and the observability hooks. Before we move to legal, procurement has two asks we need clarified for our finance committee:

1) Can Redwood provide a one-time migration credit to cover part of our on-prem integration work (CI/CD pipeline, initial ops runbook, and a week of remote assistance)?
2) We need a clearer split between the platform fee and perpetual licensing so we can decide CAPEX vs OPEX treatment.

Scope: 20 GPUs across two data centers, expected 4M tokens/day steady-state. We are looking at a 24-month commitment.

Please send a clean cost table (platform fee, per-GPU reserved pricing, support tiers and SLOs) and indicate any flexibility on migration credits or discounted first-year support.

Best,
Liam O'Connell
CPO, Clearstream Health
liam.oconnell@clearstreamhealth.com
+1 415-555-0132

--
Attachment: environment-overview.pdf (referenced)

From: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@clearstreamhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearstreamhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pricing / migration credit question for private deployment

Liam — thanks for the clarity and the numbers. Sending a preliminary commercial layout below and attaching a spreadsheet with line-item math. High level:

- Platform fee (monthly): Flat service/console/control-plane fee. Suggest we treat the first 12 months as an included implementation amortization window for accounting purposes.
- Reserved capacity: Per-GPU reserved price (discounts at 12+ GPU and 36+ GPU tiers).
- Support: Bronze/Silver/Gold tiers (Gold includes 24/7 on-call, 4h P1 response, quarterly on-site healthchecks).
- Migration credit: We can provide a one-time credit equal to 8% of first-year committed spend OR an implementation services voucher (up to $75k) — whichever better maps to your CAPEX/OPEX needs.

I've attached: Clearstream_Pricing_Grid_v2.xlsx and a draft SOW. Marissa will follow up with a more detailed amortization schedule and the per-GPU table.

Next steps: Marissa to send the full table + example invoice amortization; Naomi to advise if we can stretch to 10% credit pending finance approval.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Director, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
+1 617-555-0209

--
Attachments: Clearstream_Pricing_Grid_v2.xlsx, SOW-draft-03-01-27.docx

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@clearstreamhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearstreamhealth.com>, naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:46:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pricing / migration credit question for private deployment — detailed sheet

Diego / Liam / Priya —

Attached is the detailed pricing grid (rows show 12/24/36 month commit scenarios, columns split platform fee vs reserved GPU unit). A few clarifying notes:

- Platform fee is billed monthly and includes the control plane, model catalog maintenance, upstream security patches, and token-level analytics. For accounting, customers typically amortize over 12–24 months.
- Reserved GPU price shown is per-month per-GPU; we included 10% off list for the 20-GPU band and a second breakpoint at 36 GPUs in case Clearstream accelerates.
- Support tiers: Bronze (business hours), Silver (24/7 basic), Gold (24/7 with 4h P1 and a named TAM + quarterly ops review). Gold has an onboarding block (5 days remote + 2 onsite) included in year 1.
- Migration credit proposal: $60k implementation voucher (applies to Redwood professional services invoiced during the first 12 months) OR 9% credit of year-1 committed value, applies on invoice after activation.

I also added an amortization column demonstrating how the platform fee can be split for CAPEX treatment if your controller needs that for tax treatment.

Liam — if you can confirm which you prefer (voucher vs percent credit) we will draft a short amendment to the SOW and route to legal.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachments: Clearstream_Pricing_Grid_v2.xlsx

From: naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 08:02:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Pricing / migration credit question for private deployment — internal approval path

Team — quick internal note (diego, flagging for the pricing committee):

- $60k voucher / 9% credit: OK to approve up to 9% under standard delegated authority for strategic health-care deals < $4.5M ARR. Anything above should go to VP Sales.
- If customer requests Gold support included at no incremental fee for year 1, that materially impacts gross margin — we should instead offer a discounted Gold add-on (50% off year 1) plus a one-week on-site onboarding credit.
- Legal will want a carve-out limiting credits to professional services invoices only and a 12-month claim window from go-live.

Diego: you have delegation to offer 9% credit + $60k voucher toggle. If Clearstream asks for higher credit, escalate to Grace.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachment: Clearstream_Migration_Credit_Worksheet.pdf

From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@clearstreamhealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearstreamhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pricing / migration credit question for private deployment — Clearstream preference

Diego / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. After internal review our controller prefers CAPEX-friendly treatment, so we will take the 9% year-1 credit applied to the first invoice and request Gold support for year 1 at 50% off (to fit our budget). We also need the migration voucher to be applicable to a third-party systems integrator (we will be using CloudOps Inc). Can you confirm that the voucher can be used against partner invoices (or alternately, we want the $60k in cash credit applied to the first invoice)?

If you confirm those two items (partner-eligible voucher OR cash credit + 50% Gold year 1), we will send PO and intent to sign and request a 10-business-day turnaround on DocuSign.

Appreciate it —
Liam
